Products and Sets into 2027

Looking at Riftbound’s 2027 Releases

Hello Riftbounders, a planned feature of the second State of the Game of every year is to give players a first look at what is coming for the next year.

Secret Garden

The Secret Garden is your gateway to a lush world of alternate art cards from Riftbound.

Contents:

  • 3x Alt Art Cards

Set 5: Radiance

Own the Stage. The World is Watching.

At its core, Radiance is about performing like a master.

  • Cards: 180 (66 Showcase)
  • Hashtag: #RBRadiance
  • 3-Letter Code: RAD
  • Dates
    • Previews: Kicking off at RQ Los Angeles, September 25-27, then previews continue to run through October 9.
    • Pre-Rift: October 16-22, 2026
    • Release: October 23, 2026

Set 6: Legacy

Bear the Banner. Forge Your Legacy.

Many players have their champion, the one they love to play.

  • Cards: 346 (93 Showcase)
  • Hashtag: #RBLegacy
  • 3-Letter Code: LGC
  • Dates
    • Previews: We'll have our first Preview beat as part of Convergence Fest, December 13-15, and then previews in January.
    • Pre-Rift: January 22-28, 2027
    • Release: January 29, 2027

Set 7: The Reckoning

Awaken the Ancients

What happens when dormant behemoths are awakened? The Reckoning!

  • Cards: 264 (67 Showcase)
  • Hashtag: #RBReckoning
  • 3-Letter Code: REC
  • Dates
    • Pre-Rift: April 23-29, 2027
    • Release: April 30, 2027

Set 8

Arriving Q3 2027

That's right, we've reached the point where we haven't even locked Set 8's name yet.

Set 9

Arriving Q4 2027

Our last set of 2027 is far enough out that we've got nothing for you.
